title: tileylab/pate pipeline parameters
description: Phased Alleles from Target Enrichment (PATE) - a Nextflow pipeline for haplotype phasing of polyploid target enrichment data

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 5 columns, and a header row.

references.description: Path to directory containing per-locus reference FASTA files.
references.help_text: Each FASTA file should contain one sequence per sample/species with headers matching the samplesheet sample or species column.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits.

remove_duplicates.description: Mark and remove PCR duplicates using Picard MarkDuplicates.

unique_only.description: Output only unique phased haplotype sequences.
unique_only.help_text: When true, identical haplotype sequences are collapsed. When false, the expected number of alleles (matching ploidy) are output even if some are identical.

output_expected_dosage.description: Output ploidy-count copies of reference sequence for invariant loci.

genotype_mode.help_text: 'consensus' uses the original reference sequence. 'iupac' uses IUPAC ambiguity codes for heterozygous positions that cannot be phased.

variant_filtering.title: GATK variant filtering
variant_filtering.description: Hard filter thresholds for GATK VariantFiltration.

variant_filter_rprs.description: Read position rank sum threshold (ReadPosRankSum < X).

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config profile.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

hook_url.description: Incoming hook URL for messaging service
hook_url.help_text: Incoming hook URL for messaging service. Currently, MS Teams and Slack are supported.

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.
